upgrades.name: Permanent Slice Value
upgrades.description: Good seeds remember a productive kitchen. Every future cut benefits, including this cycle.

upgrades.name: Starting Cash
upgrades.description: A small envelope for the next beginning. Granted after your next prestige, never counted as harvest earnings.
upgrades.effect: +$5 starting cash per level on future prestige resets

upgrades.name: Golden Harvest
upgrades.description: A dedicated invitation to the rare golden specimen. Ordinary cultivation cannot open this envelope.

upgrades.name: Golden Frequency
upgrades.description: A little more room in the calendar for extraordinary produce. Cooldowns and capacity still apply.
upgrades.effect: +4 percentage points per event check per level

upgrades.name: Golden Value
upgrades.description: The rare specimen now arrives with a more persuasive invoice. The original family still shares one cut budget.
